headline: Credit Direct Expands Into Embedded Finance to Broaden Access
summary: Credit Direct, the consumer lending subsidiary of FCMB Group, is expanding beyond traditional lending into embedded finance to increase financial service accessibility in Nigeria.

impacts.name: FCMB Group
impacts.why: Strategic expansion into embedded finance diversifies lending revenue streams for financial groups.
